narration.phrase: Idris’s cupped hands and star button

narration_text.speaker: storyteller
narration_text.text: Idris borrowed the star button. He brought it back in his cupped hands.

narration_text.speaker: storyteller
narration_text.text: “I held it up when the moon looked lonely. Then I watched the whole sky fill with friends.” <sigh>

narration_text.speaker: kid_older
narration_text.text: If I borrowed that star button, I’d take it on a night walk.

narration_text.speaker: kid_older
narration_text.text: Can you add one thing we’d see? What did Idris see when he held up the button?

narration_text.speaker: storyteller
narration_text.text: He held up the little star button. Then he watched the sky fill with stars, like friends for the moon.
